svg.title: In a 775-person knee arthritis trial, 45.5% DMSO did no better than a 2.3% DMSO placebo
svg.desc: FDA label for Pennsaid, Study I, 12 weeks. Improvement in WOMAC pain score (0 to 20): placebo containing 2.3% DMSO 4.7 points, vehicle containing 45.5% DMSO 4.7 points, diclofenac in 45.5% DMSO 6.0 points. Physical function (0 to 68): 12.3, 12.1 and 15.7 points.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Strong DMSO did no better than a 2.3% DMSO placebo

svg.text: The placebo held a little DMSO so it would smell and feel like the real thing. Twenty times more DMSO added nothing;

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the drug dissolved in it, diclofenac, did the work. A second trial (Bookman 2004, 248 people) found the same: -2.5 vs -2.5.
